I answered in the negative.
Neither was there any space to put your own comments.
I guess they daren't do that.
Then they shut the surgery for a week, citing lack of power, I think it was, and that an engineer was aware.
A week? Surely a doctors surgery has (and if not, should) a system in place where an engineer comes out within an hour or two?
